_purpose: Semantic index for full-library anti-clumping query. Built once + appended per new ship.
_queryRule: For each proposed anchor: find entries with (same mood) AND (same OR adjacent narrativeType) AND (same character if named). If 3+ matches surface, flag for swap consideration. tagsComplete=false entries only support shallow checks; full semantic dedup requires tagsComplete=true.
_buildPass1Coverage: Rule-based fields (storyId, anchor, mood, era, character, narrativeType) populated for all stories. Judgment fields (subTexture, majorMotif, emotionalShape) populated only for tagsComplete=true entries.
_buildPass2Plan: Fill judgment fields progressively: 800s next, then iconic gratitude/anxious/weary, then character-cluster pairs (Sarah/Hannah, David/Joseph, etc.). Don't bulk-tag in one pass — improve batch-by-batch.
